product.name: Monoprice Blackbird 4K60 Pro 1x8 Video Splitter with HDMI HDR 18Gbps HDCP 2.2 YCbCr 444 and EDID Support
product.description: The Monoprice™ Blackbird™ 4K Pro 1x8 HDMI® Splitter with HDCP™ 2.2 support distributes a single HDMI source to eight HDMI displays. It can handle video resolutions up to a 4K@60Hz and delivers up to 18 Gbps bandwidth, assuring the best 4K picture possible.Its support for the latest High‑bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP) and HDMI specifications guarantees system compatibility and stability. Backed by Monoprice's one year warranty and support, the Monoprice Blackbird 4K Pro 1x8 HDMI Splitter is the go‑to solution for your current and future 4K switching needs.Features: Compliant with the latest HDMI® and HDCP™ specificationsSupports video resolutions up to 4K@30Hz with 24‑bit RGB/YCbCr 4:4:4/YCbCr 4:2:2, and up to 4K@60Hz with 12‑bit YCbCr 4:4:4Supports 3D frame sequential video formats up to 1080p@60HzSupports high resolution VESA® mode video formats up to QSXGA@60HzSupports 7.1‑channel LPCM, Dolby TrueHD™, and DTS‑HD Master Audio™Supports High Dynamic Range (HDR). TVs with HDR show a better, more realistic image with more contrast, brightness, and colors than ever before. HDR significantly expands contrast ratio and color accuracy. Contrast ratio is related to how bright or dark a screen is and color accuracy is how closely the colors on the screen match colors in real life. Bright images seem brighter, with more depth.Full YCbCr 4:4:4 Chroma Sampling at 4KSupport Files: User's Manual (Jul 24, 2019)Monoprice™, Blackbird™, the Blackbird logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
